title: Size of the instability locus
exact_target: How much ordinary volume does the unstable locus occupy in an analytic rational-map family, and does it have the full Hausdorff dimension of that family?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300046 (AMR-052-0046). CC BY 4.0.
Mikhail Lyubich, ``Measure and Dimension of Julia Sets'', in Ben Bielefeld and Mikhail Lyubich (eds.), Problems in Holomorphic Dynamics (1992), Problem 6, pp. 27; arXiv:math/9205209v1.
